notablePrerequisites: Basking Broodscale has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Cast the creature by paying {0}.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, and Cloudstone Curio triggers if the creature was not an artifact.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, if applicable, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
